```{r factorize_service_status}

status_levels <- 
  c("update", "some delays", "delays", "partial suspension", "no service")

simplified_statuses <- tribble(
  ~status_label,          ~simplified_status_label,  
  "delays",               "delays",
  "weekday-service",      "update",
  "local-to-express",     "partial suspension",
  "part-suspended",       "partial suspension",
  "essential-service",    "partial suspension",
  "some-delays",          "some delays",
  "express-to-local",     "some delays",
  "no-scheduled-service", "no service",
  "trains-rerouted",      "partial suspension",
  "weekend-service",      "some delays",
  "stops-skipped",        "some delays",
  "some-reroutes",        "partial suspension",
  "slow-speeds",          "some delays",
  "reroute",              "partial suspension",
  "stations-skipped",     "partial suspension",
  "suspended",            "no service",
  "multiple-changes",     "update",
  "boarding-change",      "update",
  "multiple-impacts",     "update",
  "sunday-schedule",      "some delays",
  "service-change",       "update",
  "cancellations",        "no service",
  "severe-delays",        "delays",
  "information-outage",   "update",
  "shuttle-buses-detoured",     "partial suspension", 
  "planned-work",               "update",
  "arrival-information-outage", "some delays",
  "saturday-schedule",          "some delays",
  "special-notice",             "update",
  "station-notice",             "update",
  "crowding",                   "some delays",
  "on-or-close",                "update",
  "special-event",              "update"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    simplified_status_label = factor(
      simplified_status_label,
      levels = status_levels)) 


```

```{r alert_durations}

alert_durations <- 
  service_alerts %>%
  filter(agency == "NYCT Subway") %>%
  mutate(
    status_label = str_split(status_label, fixed(" | ")),
    affected = str_split(affected, fixed(" | ")),
    date = mdy_hms(date),
    service = case_when(
      wday(date, week_start = 1) >= 6 ~ "weekend",
      hour(date) >= 5 ~ "weekday",
      TRUE ~ "weeknight")) %>%
  unnest(status_label) %>%
  unnest(affected) %>%
  left_join(simplified_statuses, by = "status_label") %>%
  group_by(event_id, service, affected) %>%
    summarise(
      n_updates = n_distinct(alert_id),
      start_time = min(date, na.rm = T),
      end_time = max(date, na.rm = T),
      most_minor_alert = 
        levels(simplified_status_label)[min(as.integer(simplified_status_label))],
      most_major_alert = 
        levels(simplified_status_label)[max(as.integer(simplified_status_label))]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(duration_est = end_time - start_time) %>%
  filter(start_time != end_time) 

# 34209 events had only a single update, so we cannot calculate the duration.  
alert_durations %>%
  count(n_updates == 1)
```

```{r}
alerts_tbl <- 
  alerts_json %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  tidyr::unnest_wider(everything(), names_sep = "_") %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  rename(
    id = id_1, 
    route_id = alert_informed_entity_route_id,
    header = alert_header_text_translation_text,
    header_avail_translations = alert_header_text_translation_language,
    description = alert_description_text_translation_text,
    description_avail_translations = alert_description_text_translation_language) 

affected_routes <- 
  alerts_tbl %>%
  select(id, route_id) %>%
  unnest(route_id)  %>%
  filter(!is.na(route_id))

headers <-
  alerts_tbl %>% 
  select(id, contains("header")) %>%
  # If they don't all have the same length, use and extra ID and the 
  #  id_col arg in pivot wider to keep everything matched up.
  # mutate(temp_id = row_number()) %>% 
  unnest(-contains("id")) %>%
  mutate(
    header_avail_translations = snakecase::to_snake_case(
      header_avail_translations)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = header_avail_translations,
    values_from = header,
    names_prefix = "header__"
  ) 

descriptions <- 
  alerts_tbl %>% 
  select(id, contains("description")) %>%
  unnest(-contains("id")) %>%
  mutate(
    description_avail_translations = snakecase::to_snake_case(
      description_avail_translations)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = description_avail_translations,
    values_from = description,
    names_prefix = "description__") 

alerts_clean <- 
  affected_routes %>% 
  inner_join(headers, by = "id") %>%
  inner_join(descriptions, by = "id") 


  
```

```{r}
my_protobuf_to_list <- function(pb_obj) {
  # Get the descriptor
  descriptor <- pb_obj$descriptor()
    
  # Get the number of fields
  field_count <- descriptor$field_count()    
    
  result <- list()
    
  for (i in 1:field_count) {
    field_name <- descriptor[[i]]$name()
    value <- pb_obj[[i]]
      
    # Recursively process if it's a message
    if (inherits(value, "Message")) {
      result[[field_name]] <- my_protobuf_to_list(value)
    } else {
      result[[field_name]] <- value
    }
  }
  
  return(result)
}


protobuf_to_list <- function(pb_obj) {
  if (inherits(pb_obj, "Message")) {
    # Get the descriptor
    descriptor <- pb_obj$descriptor()
    
    # Create an empty list to store the result
    result <- list()
    
    # Get the number of fields
    field_count <- descriptor$field_count()
    
    # Process each field by index
    for (i in 1:field_count) {
      # Get field descriptor
      # Note: field index is 0-based
      field_desc <- descriptor$field(i-1)
      
      # Get field name
      field_name <- field_desc$name()
      
      # Check if it's a repeated field
      if (field_desc$is_repeated()) {
        size <- pb_obj$fieldSize(field_name)
        
        if (size > 0) {
          # Initialize a list for repeated values
          repeated_values <- list()
          
          # Process each item in the repeated field
          for (j in 1:size) {
            item_value <- pb_obj$get(field_name, j-1)  # Zero-based index
            
            # Recursively process if it's a message
            if (inherits(item_value, "Message")) {
              repeated_values[[j]] <- protobuf_to_list(item_value)
            } else {
              repeated_values[[j]] <- item_value
            }
          }
          
          result[[field_name]] <- repeated_values
        }
      } else {
        # For non-repeated fields, try to access directly
        tryCatch({
          value <- pb_obj[[field_name]]
          
          # Only add non-NULL values to the result
          if (!is.null(value)) {
            # Recursively process if it's a message
            if (inherits(value, "Message")) {
              result[[field_name]] <- protobuf_to_list(value)
            } else {
              result[[field_name]] <- value
            }
          }
        }, error = function(e) {
          # Skip fields that can't be accessed
        })
      }
    }
    
    return(result)
  } else {
    # Return non-message objects as-is
    return(pb_obj)
  }
}
```

```{r name-based-list-fun}
# First, confirm we have the message object
class(alert)
# Should show "Message" "R6"

# Define a function to recursively convert a protobuf message to a list
protobuf_to_list <- function(pb_obj) {
  if (inherits(pb_obj, "Message")) {
    # Get field names
    descriptor <- pb_obj$descriptor()
    field_names <- names(descriptor)
    
    # Create an empty list to store the result
    result <- list()
    
    # Get the number of fields
    field_count <- descriptor$field_count()

    
    # Process each field
    for (i in field_count) {
      # Check if the field is present in the message
      
      if (pb_obj$has(field)) {
        # Get the field value
        value <- pb_obj[[field]]
        
        # If it's a repeated field, we need to handle it as a list
        if (pb_obj$descriptor()$field(field)$is_repeated()) {
          # Initialize a list for repeated values
          repeated_values <- list()
          
          # Get the size of the repeated field
          size <- pb_obj$fieldSize(field)
          
          # Process each item in the repeated field
          for (i in 1:size) {
            item_value <- pb_obj$get(field, i-1)  # Zero-based index
            
            # Recursively process if it's a message
            if (inherits(item_value, "Message")) {
              repeated_values[[i]] <- protobuf_to_list(item_value)
            } else {
              repeated_values[[i]] <- item_value
            }
          }
          
          result[[field]] <- repeated_values
        } else {
          # For non-repeated fields, recursively process if it's a message
          if (inherits(value, "Message")) {
            result[[field]] <- protobuf_to_list(value)
          } else {
            result[[field]] <- value
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    return(result)
  } else {
    # Return non-message objects as-is
    return(pb_obj)
  }
}

# Convert the alert message to a list
alert_list <- protobuf_to_list(alert)

# Now you can access the data using standard list operations
str(alert_list, max.level = 2)
```

```{r}
delays <- 
  service_alerts %>%
  filter(
    agency == "NYCT Subway",
    # Note: some delays are concatenated on a single row,
    #  like `part-suspended | trains-rerouted | delays | suspended`
    status_label == "delays") %>%
  mutate(
    affected = str_split(affected, fixed(" | ")),
    date = mdy_hms(date),
    direction = case_when(
      str_detect(header, fixed("Southbound", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Southbound",
      str_detect(header, fixed("Northbound", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Northbound",
      str_detect(header, fixed("Uptown", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Uptown",
      str_detect(header, fixed("Downtown", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Downtown",
      str_detect(header, fixed("both directions", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Both directions",
      str_detect(header, fixed("entering", ignore_case = T)) & 
         str_detect(header, fixed("leaving", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Both directions",
      TRUE ~ str_extract(header, regex(".+bound", ignore_case = T)))) %>%
  # From most cases with missing directions, the trains are simply delayed.
  replace_na(list(direction = "Both directions")) %>%
  unnest(affected) 
  
```

```{r service_pattern_summary}
shape_lengths <- 
  nyc$shapes %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  transmute(
    shape_id,
    length = sf::st_length(nyc$shapes))

days_in_service <- 
  nyc$.$dates_servicepatterns %>% 
  group_by(servicepattern_id) %>% 
  summarise(days_in_service = n())

nyc$trips %>%
  left_join(
    nyc$.$servicepatterns,
    by = "service_id") %>%
  left_join(
    shape_lengths,
    by = "shape_id") %>%
  left_join(nyc$stop_times, by = "trip_id") %>%
  group_by(servicepattern_id) %>% 
  summarise(
    trips = n(), 
    routes = n_distinct(route_id),
    total_distance_per_day_km = sum(as.numeric(length), na.rm = T) / 1000,
    route_avg_distance_km = (sum(as.numeric(length), na.rm = T) / 1000) / (trips * routes),
    stops = (n_distinct(stop_id) / 2)) %>%
  left_join(days_in_service, by = "servicepattern_id")

```

```{r hourly_headway}



get_hourly_stop_freq <- function(.gtfs, start_hr, stop_hr)  {
  .gtfs %>%
    get_stop_frequency(
      start_time = start_hr * 3600, 
      end_time = stop_hr * 3600, 
      service_ids = "Weekday", 
      by_route = T) %>%
    mutate(start_hr = start_hr, stop_hr = stop_hr) 
}


weekday_hourly_headway <- tibble(
  start_hr = c(0:23),
  stop_hr = c(0:23)) %>%
  pmap(function(start_hr, stop_hr) { 
    get_hourly_stop_freq(nyc, start_hr, stop_hr) 
  }) %>%
  list_rbind() %>%
  arrange(service_id, route_id, direction_id, start_hr)  

weekday_hourly_headway %>%
```
